question: Do immutable R40 samples establish a semantic frame-1-through-first-70-degree fluid preview window that preserves the causal contact/tip, needs at most eight Preview-96 effector subframes and fits inside the same-size domain translated to x=0.57?

derivation.windowStartRule: frame 1 preserves the initial liquid and pre-impact approach
derivation.windowEndRule: first retained sample whose solver-owned cup tilt is at least 70 degrees
derivation.contactRule: first retained cylinder-sphere surface separation at or below 0.01 m
derivation.subframeRule: ceil(maximum cup-surface displacement through derived end / 0.009375 m)
derivation.domainRule: preserve dimensions 0.90 x 0.50 x 0.58 m; translate center only to x=0.57 and require one-voxel cup-sweep margin

stopRule: Read immutable attempt-82 once, recompute the derived event window and same-size shifted-domain predicate, write one fresh evidence root and retain PASS or FAIL. Do not run Blender, change the Bullet trajectory, start liquid or reinterpret the original full-window FAIL.
claimCeiling: Eligibility only for a future bounded event-window liquid Preview experiment; not proof that all liquid has spilled by 70 degrees, not a liquid PASS, and not a render or film-quality claim.
